item.title: LeT operative involved in 26/11 Mumbai attack dies in Pak; poisoning speculated
item.summary: In a puzzling incident, a prominent Lashkar-e-Taiba member, Qari Saeed Abdul Aziz, was found dead in Islamabad on August 8. Known for his role in orchestrating the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, Aziz collapsed near a mosque after a meal at an unfamiliar restaurant. While the exact cause of death is still being investigated, the possibility of poisoning has not been ruled out, prompting close scrutiny from regional intelligence.
